item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00425","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C03","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.95,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C23 plausibly supplied material language and administrative machinery for the child. It assigns Defense Production Act responsibilities among departments and agencies, charges them with developing measures for expanding productive capacity, and gives the National Security Resources Board Chairman a coordinating role involving reports, information, and interagency action. The child directly invokes those assigned responsibilities and adapts the same machinery to processing necessity certificates and capacity expansion. C03 and C02 share the compact two-step structure of designating an authority and requiring other agencies to assist it, but their subject matter and operative details are less closely connected.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Chairman of the National Security Resources Board is hereby designated as the certifying authority","parent_excerpt":"The Chairman of the National Security Resources Board shall, in the interest of assisting the President to coordinate the functions delegated by this Executive order","explanation":"Both place the Board Chairman in a central administrative role concerning functions associated with the defense-production program."},{"child_excerpt":"the Chairman shall utilize departments and agencies of the Government according to their respective assigned responsibilities pursuant to the Defense Production Act of 1950","parent_excerpt":"The functions conferred upon the President by Title I of the Defense Production Act of 1950 are hereby delegated as follows","explanation":"The child expressly relies on the distribution of agency responsibilities established in C23 and converts that distribution into the operating framework for certificate review."},{"child_excerpt":"To furnish reports and recommendations in respect of applications for necessity certificates","parent_excerpt":"Obtain reports and information on the status of work in the various agencies designated in this Executive order","explanation":"The reporting mechanism is adapted from C23's interagency coordination provisions."},{"child_excerpt":"To develop necessary programs for the expansion of capacity","parent_excerpt":"shall develop and promote measures for the expansion of productive capacity and of production and supply of materials and facilities necessary for the national defense","explanation":"This is a particularly close substantive and verbal parallel concerning programs or measures for expansion of productive capacity."}]}
